name: Pilot Protocol
description: Discover specialist agents and exchange messages with trusted peers.
installHint: Run `npx -y pilotprotocol-mcp setup` once before first use: it fetches and starts the Pilot daemon (`pilotctl`) and writes this server's MCP config into the agent tools it detects, OpenHands included. The `npx -y pilotprotocol-mcp` command this entry runs starts the stdio server and expects that daemon to be present already; without it, it exits with `pilotctl binary not found`. The local transport runs entirely on your machine, and the hosted control plane earlier releases used has been retired, so no third party is in the path.
